meta.status: DRAFT - separate held-out set. Labels drafted by the model and each checked against the source text (frozen corpus chunk or the raw filing HTML table row); NOT independent human labels. Items with review=true need a human decision.
meta.protocol: Written before any run on it. Not used for tuning: run once, after every code change for this pass was final. Retrieval is scored by content (a top-5 chunk from the stated document containing every 'contains' string), not by chunk id, because table chunks are new and prose chunk ids are positional.
meta.corpus: Stage-C evaluation corpus: the frozen 2026-10-19 corpus (prose unchanged) + reporting-period backfill + table chunks for NVDA/MSFT/JPM 2024-2026 filings.
meta.independence: Different facts from the 20-question development set; companies AAPL/AMZN/TSLA/META were not in the development set.

items.question: How many full-time equivalent employees did Apple have at the end of fiscal year 2025?

evidence.quote: As of September 27, 2025, the Company had approximately 166,000 full-time equivalent employees

items.question: How many full-time and part-time employees did Amazon employ as of December 31, 2024?

evidence.quote: As of December 31, 2024, we employed approximately 1,556,000 full-time and part-time employees

items.question: How many consumer vehicles did Tesla deliver in 2024?

evidence.quote: In 2024, we produced approximately 1,773,000 consumer vehicles and delivered approximately 1,789,000 consumer vehicles

items.traps: 2024 10-Qs give year-to-date figures (~387,000 through Q1, ~831,000 through Q2); 2023: 1,808,581
items.review_note: The filing states an approximation; an answer quoting 1,789,000 without 'approximately' is still treated as correct.
